subject: prd/local-work-tracker
statement: When asked to add or remove a dependency edge (`blocked_by`, including a cross-repo reference form), the tracker shall maintain the edge both directions, and shall refuse any edge that would create a cycle, naming the cycle.
rationale: dependency order at every level; a cycle would deadlock readiness
fit_criterion: blockers and blocking both resolve; a cycle-forming edge is refused with the cycle named
